svg.title: Inside the hive
svg.desc: One select_skills call. Models are optional: without them the rest still works. Reads the task, project, phase, history and feedback; signals vote; quorum, rerank, cards, taste and roles choose; it hands over ordered skills, a bundle, a gap and what is likely next.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
